items.title: DaVita and Humana Expand Kidney Care Partnership to More Than 10,000 Patients
items.summary: DaVita (NYSE:DVA) has expanded its partnership with Humana (NYSE:HUM) through a new value-based care agreement covering more than 10,000 Medicare Advantage members living with chronic kidney disease. The programme, which launched on July 1, targets patients with stages 3B through 5 chronic kidney disease (CKD).

items.title: Berkshire ups Alphabet stake under Greg Abel, making it a top-3 holding
items.summary: Berkshire Hathaway (BRK-A, BRK-B), under new CEO Greg Abel, increased its Alphabet position, making the Google parent its third-largest U.S.-listed equity holding by market value, behind Apple (AAPL) and American Express (AXP). According to a new filing, Berkshire held roughly 106 million Alphabet shares, valued at $37.9 billion, as of the end of June. Recent reporting confirms Berkshire invested about $10 billion in Alphabet during the second quarter.

items.title: The Top 5 Analyst Questions From DaVita’s Q2 Earnings Call
items.summary: DaVita’s second quarter results surpassed Wall Street’s revenue and adjusted profit expectations, but the market response was notably negative. Management attributed this to a mix of operational and industry-specific challenges, including flat treatment volumes and sequential declines in revenue per treatment, primarily due to a less favorable commercial mix and reduced revenue from phosphate binders.
